watch.summary: The streamer laughs and jokes that GTA 6 is going to cost $200 while watching clips of gameplay.

beats.what: Streamer watches footage of kayaking and footage of a city scene.
Streamer says the game is going to cost $200.
Streamer laughs at his own comment and continues watching.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: This game's really gonna be like $200.
watch.why: The clip relies on a mild hyperbolic joke about gaming prices and high production quality. It functions as casual stream commentary rather than a punchy stand-alone comedy beat.
